verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has nothing on versioning, reviewing, or rolling back automation definitions themselves (graphs, assistants, or deployments). Checkpointer 'time travel' rewinds a thread's execution state, not the automation's version. API path-versioning covers the control-plane API, not user automations. The dev/test-then-deploy workflow describes staging, not version history or rollback. These are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
